children: Cipla Ltd (NSE:CIPLA) reported a mixed quarter with revenue and profit misses, regional wins in India and South Africa, FDA observations at multiple plants but no enforcement, Rs9,823cr net cash and steady R&D, pledged oncology margin compliance while shares dipped and Nomura set a Dec‑2027 target.
Previous Week Recap
Cipla Ltd Q2 Revenue Decline; North America Fall, India Growth

: Cipla Ltd reported Q2 revenue and profit declines, missed estimates. EBITDA margin around company guidance. North America sales fell while India sales grew; U.S. sales rose QoQ with planned launches.
Cipla Verna Plant FDA Classification Voluntary Action Indicated
: Cipla Ltd’s Verna, Goa plant received a US FDA classification of “voluntary action indicated” after a Q1FY27 GMP inspection, requiring corrective actions; no enforcement action was imposed.
FDA 483 At Invagen NY; Near-Term Indore Reinspection
: FDA completed July GMP audit at Cipla’s Invagen NY facility and issued a Form 483; company expects near-term reinspection of its Indore plant.
Cipla To Follow Margin Cap For Oncology
: Cipla (CIPLA) will follow the government's trade margin cap for certain cancer drugs under Supreme Court oversight, saying it will comply with the new margin limits for affected oncology products.
Cipla Net Cash Rs 9,823 Cr; R&D Rs 423 Cr
: Cipla (CIPLA) holds net cash of Rs 9,823 crore; debt mainly lease liabilities and working capital borrowings. R&D spend Rs 423 crore, about 5.7% of sales.
Nomura Sets Cipla Target 25x Dec‑2027 EPS
: Nomura sets Cipla target using 25x Dec‑2027 EPS of Rs 60.4. Its revenue forecast is ~1% below consensus; EBITDA and PAT estimates are ~6% above consensus.
Cipla Shares Fall After Results
: Cipla Ltd (CIPLA) shares fell after quarterly results, trading around ₹1,347, down about 0.6% intraday and intraday low near ₹1,319, while pharma peers rose.
Cipla SA Private Business Outperforms Market
: Cipla Ltd (CIPLA): South Africa private business grew faster than the overall market in the quarter, showing regional outperformance; no further financial details or timeframes were provided.
Rashmi Joshi Independent Director Approved
: Cipla approved Rashmi Joshi as independent director (five-year term from Oct 27, 2026) pending shareholder OK. Joshi is a chartered accountant with 30+ years’ finance and board experience.
